title: Tribes East of Jordan

questions.question: Which tribes asked for land east of the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Numbers 32:1 (ESV): "Now the people of Reuben and the people of Gad had a very great number of livestock..."

questions.question: Why did they want this land (Jazer and Gilead)?
questions.explanation: Numbers 32:1 (ESV): "They saw the land of Jazer... was a place for livestock."

questions.question: How did Moses initially react to their request?
options: He thought they were discouraging the people from crossing over
questions.correctAnswer: He thought they were discouraging the people from crossing over
questions.explanation: Numbers 32:7 (ESV): "Why will you discourage the heart of the people of Israel from going over..."

questions.question: What historical event did Moses remind them of?
questions.explanation: Numbers 32:8 (ESV): "So your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land."

questions.question: What promise did the Reubenites and Gadites make?
options: We will build sheepfolds here, but we will go armed before Israel until they inherit
questions.correctAnswer: We will build sheepfolds here, but we will go armed before Israel until they inherit
questions.explanation: Numbers 32:17 (ESV): "But we will take up arms, ready to go before the people of Israel..."

questions.question: Moses said if they didn't keep their word, what would happen?
options: "Be sure your sin will find you out"
questions.correctAnswer: "Be sure your sin will find you out"
questions.explanation: Numbers 32:23 (ESV): "Behold, you have sinned against the Lord, and be sure your sin will find you out."

questions.question: Which half-tribe also received inheritance east of the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Numbers 32:33 (ESV): "Moses gave to them... and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph..."

questions.question: What did they build for their little ones?
options: Fortified cities and folds for sheep
questions.correctAnswer: Fortified cities and folds for sheep
questions.explanation: Numbers 32:36 (ESV): "And fortified cities, and folds for sheep."

questions.question: Machir the son of Manasseh dispossessed whom?
questions.explanation: Numbers 32:39 (ESV): "And the sons of Machir... went to Gilead... and dispossessed the Amorites..."

questions.question: Jair the son of Manasseh captured villages and called them what?
If they refuse to cross over armed, what penalty did Moses set?
options: They shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan (forced to move West)
questions.correctAnswer: They shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan (forced to move West)
questions.explanation: Numbers 32:30 (ESV): "But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan."

questions.question: Who did Moses give charge concerning them?
options: Eleazar, Joshua, and the heads of the fathers' houses
questions.correctAnswer: Eleazar, Joshua, and the heads of the fathers' houses
questions.explanation: Numbers 32:28 (ESV): "So Moses gave command concerning them to Eleazar the priest and to Joshua..."

questions.question: Did the tribes return to their homes immediately after crossing?
options: No, "We will not return to our homes until each of the people of Israel has gained his inheritance"
questions.correctAnswer: No, "We will not return to our homes until each of the people of Israel has gained his inheritance"
questions.explanation: Numbers 32:18 (ESV): "We will not return to our homes until..."

questions.question: Nobah captured Kenath and called it what?
questions.explanation: Numbers 32:42 (ESV): "And Nobah went and captured Kenath... and called it Nobah, after his own name."

questions.question: Why did Moses reference the "brood of sinful men"?
options: To warn them not to rise up in their fathers' place to increase God's anger
questions.correctAnswer: To warn them not to rise up in their fathers' place to increase God's anger
questions.explanation: Numbers 32:14 (ESV): "And behold, you have risen in your fathers' place, a brood of sinful men, to increase still more the fierce anger of the Lord..."

key_verse_text: But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against the Lord, and be sure your sin will find you out.
